title: Fire Protection — Engine and Auxiliary Power Unit Fire Detection Loop Connector Sealing
abstract: Replacement of every fire detection loop connector by a sealed standard with a rear grommet and moulded boot, the overnight half of the response to false fire warnings on wet turnarounds.

sections.planning_reason: Seventeen false engine fire warnings were recorded in a single wet season across the Auran 7000 fleet, every one on the first flight after a heavy rain turnaround and every one clearing after the loop dried. Water was found tracking into the loop connector at the pylon break. A false fire warning is an air turnback and a full inspection, so the operational cost is high even though nothing is on fire. This bulletin addresses the connector; the companion bulletin moves the loop out of the drain path.
sections.description: Every connector on the engine and auxiliary power unit fire detection loops is replaced by a sealed standard with a rear grommet and a moulded boot, and each connector is subjected to an insulation resistance measurement before and after. No routing is changed by this bulletin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the engine is cold and that the fire bottles are safetied. WARNING: DO NOT DISCONNECT A FIRE DETECTION LOOP WITH THE FIRE BOTTLE ARMED. Do AMM-S-26-10-11-200-052-A to measure the insulation resistance at every connector on both loops and record the readings. Disconnect each connector in turn and fit the sealed shell, the rear grommet and the moulded boot from the kit, using the rivets AGS49442-85 where a bracket must be renewed. Refit the transmitter D2610111824651 on its existing bracket. Refit the regulator 25WD in the auxiliary power unit compartment without changing its clip positions. Re-measure the insulation resistance at every connector and confirm that each reading is above the limit given in the accomplishment instructions. Do the fire detection system operational test on both loops and on the auxiliary power unit loop. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-38 and SOLANO-39 aircraft with Auran 7000 engines. Aircraft from MSN S01741 onward are post-modification from build. Operators in wet climates are advised to accomplish this Service Bulletin and the companion routing bulletin together, but either may be done alone and in either order.
sections.material_note: Kit K2610-1022-01 covers one aircraft and contains the sealed shells, grommets and boots for all loop connectors, plus a small quantity of rivets for bracket renewal. Lead time is nine weeks. Nothing is returned.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the start of the next wet season, or within 12 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
